text:
emma_sales: Customer in a sealed datacenter requested POC constraints doc. They need: chunked sideload (2GB max), detached signatures, signed SBOM (SPDX), offline activation token, 36-48mo retention, and a ballpark for packaging + signing + retention fees. Any blockers?

diego_se: We can do all of that. Output: chunked tar.gz + chunk-manifest.json (names + sha256), final bundle.tar.gz + detached COSE (ES256). We can emit SPDX 2.2 in bundle metadata. Offline activation: we generate a signed activation token (TTL configurable).

sarah_ops: Retention: default delta 6mo / full 18mo. 36-48mo possible but will be charged as archive storage; also requires SOW clause. HSM signing: supported as a PS engagement (customer-owned or managed).

security_bot: Note: key rotation scheduled; for sealed envs we can pin a public key in SOW. If they want HSM, we need extra security review.

legal_ops: Pricing hooks: one-time packaging & jumpbox integration, per-release validation fee, monthly archive storage for >18mo, HSM setup + monthly if we host. Also require SOW acceptance for extended cert rotation and delayed patching risk.

emma_sales: Customer asked for a short one-pager. Can someone draft the manifest snippet + cost bullets and drop link here today?

diego_se: I'll draft the one-pager with chunk-manifest example and verification steps. ETA 3h.

emma_sales: Thanks — I'll get back with whether they require HSM or single egress IP for activation. Closing until customer responds.
